{
  "verdict": "revise",
  "score": 0.62,
  "reasons": [
    "Metric name mismatch: operating_temp_range_width_C should be operating_temp_range_C to align with the instruction.",
    "Column naming for safety and recycling uses suffixes _0_100 (safety_score_0_100, recycling_score_0_100) instead of the requested safety_score and recycling_score.",
    "Normalization/scores section is labeled differently (energy_density_score, cost_score, etc.) and may not directly map to the requested metric names; ensure a clean 0–100 per metric with sodium and lithium columns.",
    "Deliverable mentions saving a CSV and a 1-page analysis; artifact includes analysis but formatting is inconsistent with a clean CSV and standalone short analysis page."
  ],
  "guidance": "Provide a corrected deliverable: (1) a CSV with header metric,sodium_central,sodium_uncertainty,lithium_central,lithium_uncertainty and rows named exactly as: energy_density_Wh_per_kg, cost_per_kWh_USD, cycle_life_cycles, calendar_life_years, round_trip_efficiency_pct, usable_DOD_pct, operating_temp_range_C, safety_score, recycling_score. Each row should include central and uncertainty values for both ions (as in the artifact). (2) a separate, standalone 1-page analysis summary detailing key numeric differences and the defensible weighting rationale used to compute the overall suitability score. Ensure the CSV and the analysis are saved as separate files and that the names clearly reflect the metrics and scores."
}
